17: package log
18: 
19: import (
20: 	"fmt"
21: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/log/field"
22: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/loggers"
23: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/loggers/console"
24: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/loggers/zap"
25: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/timeutils"
26: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/config/coordinate"
27: 	"github.com/spf13/afero"
28: 	"golang.org/x/net/context"
29: 	"io"
30: 	"os"
31: 	"path/filepath"
32: )
33: 
34: const (
35: 	LogDirectory                 = ".logs"
36: 	LogFileTimestampPrefixFormat = "20060102-150405"
37: )
38: 
39: // CtxKeyCoord context key used for contextual coordinate information
40: type CtxKeyCoord struct{}
41: 
42: // CtxKeyEnv context key used for contextual environment information
43: type CtxKeyEnv struct{}
44: 
45: // CtxValEnv context value used for contextual environment information
46: type CtxValEnv struct {
47: 	Name  string
48: 	Group string
49: }
50: 
51: // CtxGraphComponentId context key used for correlating logs that belong to deployment of a sub graph
52: type CtxGraphComponentId struct{}
53: 
54: // CtxValGraphComponentId context value used for correlating logs that belong to deployment of a sub graph
55: type CtxValGraphComponentId int
56: 
57: var (
58: 	_ loggers.Logger = (*zap.Logger)(nil)
59: 	_ loggers.Logger = (*console.Logger)(nil)
60: )
61: 
62: func Fatal(msg string, a ...interface{}) {
63: 	std.Fatal(msg, a...)
64: }
65: 
66: func Error(msg string, a ...interface{}) {
67: 	std.Error(msg, a...)
68: }
69: 
70: func Warn(msg string, a ...interface{}) {
71: 	std.Warn(msg, a...)
72: }
73: 
74: func Info(msg string, a ...interface{}) {
75: 	std.Info(msg, a...)
76: }
77: 
78: func Debug(msg string, a ...interface{}) {
79: 	std.Debug(msg, a...)
80: }
81: 
82: func Level() loggers.LogLevel {
83: 	return std.Level()
84: }
85: 
86: // WithFields adds additional [field.Field] for structured logs
87: // It accepts vararg fields and should not be called more than once per log call
88: func WithFields(fields ...field.Field) loggers.Logger {
89: 	return std.WithFields(fields...)
90: }
91: 
92: // WithCtxFields creates a logger instance with preset structured logging [field.Field] based on the Context
93: // Coordinate (via [CtxKeyCoord]) and environment (via [CtxKeyEnv] [CtxValEnv]) information is added to logs from the Context
94: func WithCtxFields(ctx context.Context) loggers.Logger {
95: 	loggr := std
96: 	f := make([]field.Field, 0, 2)
97: 	if c, ok := ctx.Value(CtxKeyCoord{}).(coordinate.Coordinate); ok {
98: 		f = append(f, field.Coordinate(c))
99: 	}
100: 	if e, ok := ctx.Value(CtxKeyEnv{}).(CtxValEnv); ok {
101: 		f = append(f, field.Environment(e.Name, e.Group))
102: 	}
103: 
104: 	if c, ok := ctx.Value(CtxGraphComponentId{}).(CtxValGraphComponentId); ok {
105: 		f = append(f, field.F("gid", c))
106: 	}
107: 	return loggr.WithFields(f...)
108: }
109: 
110: var (
111: 	std loggers.Logger = console.Instance
112: )
113: 
114: func PrepareLogging(fs afero.Fs, verbose bool, loggerSpy io.Writer) {
115: 	loglevel := loggers.LevelInfo
116: 	if verbose {
117: 		loglevel = loggers.LevelDebug
118: 	}
119: 
120: 	logFile, errFile, err := prepareLogFiles(fs)
121: 	logFormat := loggers.ParseLogFormat(os.Getenv(loggers.EnvVarLogFormat))
122: 	logTime := loggers.ParseLogTimeMode(os.Getenv(loggers.EnvVarLogTime))
123: 
124: 	setDefaultLogger(loggers.LogOptions{
125: 		File:        logFile,
126: 		ErrorFile:   errFile,
127: 		JSONLogging: logFormat == loggers.LogFormatJSON,
128: 		LogLevel:    loglevel,
129: 		LogSpy:      loggerSpy,
130: 		LogTimeMode: logTime,
131: 	})
132: 
133: 	if err != nil {
134: 		Warn(err.Error())
135: 	}
136: }
137: 
138: // LogFilePath returns the path of a logfile for the current execution time - depending on when this function is called such a file may not yet exist
139: func LogFilePath() string {
140: 	timestamp := timeutils.TimeAnchor().Format(LogFileTimestampPrefixFormat)
141: 	return filepath.Join(LogDirectory, timestamp+".log")
142: }
143: 
144: // ErrorFilePath returns the path of an error logfile for the current execution time - depending on when this function is called such a file may not yet exist
145: func ErrorFilePath() string {
146: 	timestamp := timeutils.TimeAnchor().Format(LogFileTimestampPrefixFormat)
147: 	return filepath.Join(LogDirectory, timestamp+"-errors.log")
148: }
149: 
150: // prepareLogFiles tries to create a LogDirectory (if none exists) and a file each to write all logs and filtered error
151: // logs to. As errors in preparing log files are viewed as optional for the logger setup using this method, partial data
152: // may be returned in case of errors.
153: // If log directory or logFile creation fails, no log files are returned.
154: // If errLog creation fails, a valid logFile is still being returned with an error.
155: func prepareLogFiles(fs afero.Fs) (logFile afero.File, errFile afero.File, err error) {
156: 	if err := fs.MkdirAll(LogDirectory, 0777); err != nil {
157: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to prepare log directory %s: %w", LogDirectory, err)
158: 
159: 	}
160: 
161: 	logFilePath := LogFilePath()
162: 	logFile, err = fs.OpenFile(logFilePath, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND, 0644)
163: 	if err != nil {
164: 		return nil, nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to prepare log file in %s directory: %w", LogDirectory, err)
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	errFilePath := ErrorFilePath()
168: 	errFile, err = fs.OpenFile(errFilePath, os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_APPEND, 0644)
169: 	if err != nil {
170: 		return logFile, nil, fmt.Errorf("unable to prepare error file in %s directory: %w", LogDirectory, err)
171: 	}
172: 
173: 	return logFile, errFile, nil
174: 
175: }
176: 
177: func setDefaultLogger(opts loggers.LogOptions) {
178: 	logger, err := zap.New(opts)
179: 	if err != nil {
180: 		panic(err)
181: 	}
182: 	std = logger
183: }

17: package bucket
18: 
19: import (
20: 	"context"
21: 	"encoding/json"
22: 	"fmt"
23: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code-core/api/clients/buckets"
24: 	tools "github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/buckettools"
25: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/idutils"
26: 	jsonutils "github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/json"
27: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/log"
28: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/log/field"
29: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/internal/raw"
30: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/config"
31: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/config/coordinate"
32: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/config/parameter"
33: 	"github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/config/template"
34: 	v2 "github.com/dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code/v2/pkg/project/v2"
35: )
36: 
37: type BucketClient interface {
38: 	List(ctx context.Context) (buckets.ListResponse, error)
39: }
40: 
41: type Downloader struct {
42: 	client BucketClient
43: }
44: 
45: func NewDownloader(client BucketClient) *Downloader {
46: 	return &Downloader{
47: 		client: client,
48: 	}
49: }
50: func (d *Downloader) Download(projectName string, _ ...config.BucketType) (v2.ConfigsPerType, error) { // error in return is just to complain to interface
51: 	result := make(v2.ConfigsPerType)
52: 	response, err := d.client.List(context.TODO())
53: 	if err != nil {
54: 		log.WithFields(field.Type("bucket"), field.Error(err)).Error("Failed to fetch all bucket definitions: %v", err)
55: 		return nil, nil
56: 	}
57: 
58: 	if apiErr, isErr := response.AsAPIError(); isErr {
59: 		log.WithFields(field.Type("bucket"), field.Error(apiErr)).Error("Failed to fetch all bucket definitions: %v", apiErr)
60: 		return nil, nil
61: 	}
62: 
63: 	configs := d.convertAllObjects(projectName, response.Objects)
64: 	result["bucket"] = configs
65: 	return result, nil
66: }
67: 
68: func (d *Downloader) convertAllObjects(projectName string, objects [][]byte) []config.Config {
69: 	result := make([]config.Config, 0, len(objects))
70: 	for _, o := range objects {
71: 
72: 		c, err := convertObject(o, projectName)
73: 		if err != nil {
74: 			log.WithFields(field.Coordinate(coordinate.Coordinate{Project: c.Coordinate.Project, Type: "bucket", ConfigId: c.Coordinate.ConfigId}), field.Error(err)).
75: 				Warn("Failed to get configuration for %v (%s): %v", c.Coordinate.ConfigId, "bucket", err)
76: 			continue
77: 		}
78: 
79: 		if tools.IsDefault(c.OriginObjectId) {
80: 			log.Debug("Skipping default Grail bucket %q", c.OriginObjectId)
81: 			continue
82: 		}
83: 		result = append(result, *c)
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	log.Info("Downloaded %d Grail buckets", len(result))
87: 
88: 	return result
89: }
90: 
91: const (
92: 	bucketName  = "bucketName"
93: 	displayName = "displayName"
94: )
95: 
96: func convertObject(o []byte, projectName string) (*config.Config, error) {
97: 	c := config.Config{
98: 		Coordinate: coordinate.Coordinate{
99: 			Project: projectName,
100: 			Type:    "bucket",
101: 		},
102: 		Type: config.BucketType{},
103: 	}
104: 
105: 	r, err := raw.New(o)
106: 	if err != nil {
107: 		return &c, err
108: 	}
109: 
110: 	id, ok := r.Get(bucketName).(string)
111: 	if !ok {
112: 		return &c, fmt.Errorf("variable %q unreadable", bucketName)
113: 	}
114: 
115: 	// construct config object with generated config ID
116: 	configID := idutils.GenerateUUIDFromString(id)
117: 	c.Coordinate = coordinate.Coordinate{
118: 		Project:  projectName,
119: 		Type:     "bucket",
120: 		ConfigId: configID,
121: 	}
122: 
123: 	c.OriginObjectId = r.Get(bucketName).(string)
124: 
125: 	r.Delete(bucketName)
126: 
127: 	c.Parameters = map[string]parameter.Parameter{}
128: 	p := r.Parameterize(displayName)
129: 	if p != nil {
130: 		c.Parameters[displayName] = p
131: 	}
132: 
133: 	t, err := r.ToJSON()
134: 	if err != nil {
135: 		return &c, err
136: 	}
137: 	c.Template = template.NewDownloadTemplate(configID, configID, string(jsonutils.MarshalIndent(t)))
138: 
139: 	return &c, nil
140: }
141: 
142: func getValueForAttribute(raw []byte, name string) (string, error) {
143: 	var m map[string]any
144: 	err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m)
145: 	if err != nil {
146: 		return "", err
147: 	}
148: 	if m[name] != nil {
149: 		return fmt.Sprintf("%v", m[name]), nil
150: 
151: 	}
152: 	return "", nil
153: }
